objectives: Recognise squ at the start of taught words.
Hear /s/ followed by the /kw/ sequence in taught examples.
Blend the onset smoothly without inserting an extra vowel.
Distinguish squ from scr, str, and sw.
concepts: In this taught set, squ represents /s/ followed by /kw/.
The spelling includes q followed by u.
Blend the onset with the rest of the word.
The whole word confirms accurate recognition.

definitions.definition: A letter or group of letters representing a sound.
Consonant sounds heard together at the beginning of a word.
Joining speech sounds in order to say a word.

workedExamples.solution: Hear /s/ followed by /kw/, then blend the rest of the word.
Squid begins squ; skid begins sk.
Keep the initial /s/ and /kw/ sequence together.

commonMistakes: Reading q without the following u.
Adding an extra vowel between sounds.
keyTakeaways: In the taught examples, squ represents /s/ plus /kw/.
Remember q is followed by u.
Check the spelling and sound sequence.
revisionPoints: Keep q and u together in the spelling.
